parent_binding.noncircularity: Future verifier source and result hashes are controller-added outside this self-hash-free contract after delivery.

verification_contract: independently evaluate the four literal BBP poles for every requested N using a verifier-owned normalized signed (numerator,positive denominator) representation reduced by gcd
reconstruct each partial directly from the four literal poles and derive F_N from the exact difference between independently reconstructed consecutive endpoints
reconstruct Q_N,F_N,H_N,d_N,e_N,X_N,k_N,W_N,R_N and cell without importing or inferring generator intermediates
check N means successor N+1, inclusive P_N through 7*N, next-seven forcing, positive denominators, Euclidean remainder, and Int.ediv cell
in tiny_point mode compare every canonical point byte/value and return an exact structured mismatch list

in future_window_256 mode independently recompute from literal-route points exactly the entire parent/S0 canonical artifact: ten counts, J, all 255 positive-lag C/A/Z records, raw maximum ratio and lexicographically first tie witness, and decision fields; C0=256 is derived and enforced internally and is never emitted; use independently owned statistic code and do not trust generator summaries; the controller enforces mandatory identities over emitted fields and no extra identity fields may be emitted; window13_action is operational only at window_index 13

all full-artifact types, keys, ordering, formulas, canonical bytes, and decision precedence are delegated exactly to the frozen parent specifications and accepted S0 schema; stdout and candidate VERIFIED text have no authority

forbidden: the S1 combined numerator identity or formula
copying generator intermediates or expected outputs

controller_test_hook: A controller-only isolated hook may pass synthetic canonical point records directly into S2's independently owned statistic function. It is not exposed by the production CLI, is unreachable from production jobs, cannot select arithmetic inputs, and returns the exact parent/S0 artifact solely for hidden statistics tests.

allowed: read controller job and immutable CAS copy

source_separation: Physically separate source tree and image from S1; the controller mounts generator bytes by CAS digest only after generator exit.

mutations: unscaled F missing the exact 10^(N+1) factor

third_route_requirement: Controller-owned third-route oracle must agree record-by-record on all tiny shards; agreement between S1 and S2 alone is insufficient.
activation_preconditions: S1 source is frozen but unavailable to S2
literal route and independently owned statistic code pass static audit
tiny mutations and independent third-route comparisons pass
hidden synthetic 256-point artifacts exercise independent counts/J/all C/A/Z/max/tie/decision recomputation and mismatch rejection
nonclaims: A verifier verdict is not a controller receipt and computes no production window or Pi result.
